ASSIGNMENT.TITLE: Human service distribution
ASSIGNMENT.HELP: After the flow selects a team, assign to an online member of both that team and the original inbox, with the fewest open conversations across this account. If nobody is available, keep the conversation in the human queue. The reply number stays unchanged.
ASSIGNMENT.INBOXES: Apply only to these inboxes. Other inboxes keep their current assignment rules.
ASSIGNMENT.NO_INBOXES: Create an inbox before enabling distribution.
ASSIGNMENT.CAPACITY: Maximum open conversations per agent across all inboxes
ASSIGNMENT.ERROR: Could not load or save the settings. Refresh and try again.

JRC_BROKER.ADOPT_HELP: Link an existing Broker inbox without recreating it or changing its conversation history.
JRC_BROKER.CONNECTIONS_HELP: Check your inbox connection and scan its QR code without opening a conversation.
JRC_BROKER.NO_CONNECTIONS: No JRC WhatsApp inbox is available to you in this account. Ask an administrator to link your inbox and assign your access.
JRC_BROKER.AGENT_CONNECTIONS_HELP: Reconnection is available to authorized inbox members. An administrator approves the first connection and any change of business number.
JRC_BROKER.TITLE: WhatsApp — JRC Broker
JRC_BROKER.GRANTS_HELP: Allow selected inbox members to reconnect the approved business number. They cannot create a new connection, change the number or disconnect WhatsApp. Removing an agent from the inbox removes this permission.
JRC_BROKER.DESCRIPTION: Connect and manage your company's WhatsApp through JRC.
JRC_BROKER.DISABLED: JRC Broker is not enabled for this account.
JRC_BROKER.UNVERIFIED_HELP: An inbox or connected number alone does not confirm delivery. Both incoming and outgoing messages must be verified.
JRC_BROKER.EXPIRED: This code has expired. Request a new code when you are ready.

PAIR_PROGRESS.SUCCEEDED: The connection step finished without a reusable QR. Request a new code to continue.
PAIR_PROGRESS.FAILED: The connection attempt failed. Check the inbox status, then request a new code.
PAIR_PROGRESS.UNKNOWN: The result is uncertain. Check the connection state before another request and ask an administrator if it stays uncertain.

JRC_BROKER.IDENTITY_WARNING: Confirm that the WhatsApp number ending in {suffix} belongs to this inbox. A different number pauses delivery until an administrator approves it.
JRC_BROKER.DISCONNECT_WARNING: Disconnecting stops this inbox from sending and receiving WhatsApp messages until it is connected again.
JRC_BROKER.UNDERSTAND: I have checked the number and understand the effect on this inbox.
JRC_BROKER.CONFIG_HELP: An administrator must approve this Chatwoot account in the Broker and issue its limited control key. The key is stored encrypted on the server and is never shown to agents.
JRC_BROKER.CONFIGURED: Account configuration saved. The stored key cannot be displayed.
JRC_BROKER.RETRY_INTENT: Check and retry the same request
JRC_BROKER.UNCERTAIN: The response was interrupted. The request may have been accepted. Retry the same request or resume an operation below.
JRC_BROKER.CANCEL_SETUP: Cancel setup and keep created resources
JRC_BROKER.UNKNOWN_HELP: The result is uncertain. Check the existing inbox before attempting another creation.

ERROR.INVALID_SETUP: The setup request was rejected. Check your access and the connection details before trying again.
ERROR.DENIED: This action is no longer available. Ask your account administrator to check your access.
ERROR.CONFLICT: The previous connection attempt needs review. Check this inbox and ask an administrator to reconcile it before requesting another code.
ERROR.UNAVAILABLE: Could not reach the Broker. The inbox and connection have been preserved. Try again shortly.
ERROR.CONFIGURATION: Could not validate this configuration. Check the approved account, origin and control key.
